full_sentence: It is cold outside, so I wear my warm coat.
acceptable_variants: I put on my warm hat.

options.text: I eat ice cream every day.
options.why_wrong: Eating ice cream does not follow logically from cold weather, so it does not give a result of the cold.
This is a fact about the park. It is not a result of the cold weather, so it does not complete the sentence.
A job has no logical link to the weather, so it does not complete the result that 'so' introduces.

explanation: 'So' introduces the result of the first part of the sentence. Because the weather is cold, the logical result is wearing a warm coat.
translation: Надворі холодно, тому я одягаю теплу куртку.
